description: `Object.assign(t, o)` reads each source's own enumerable members, so it consults get over them exactly as spread does. The call to `Object.assign` itself floors bodyless in both functions: the baseline that colors it is the baseline-integration ticket's, not this one's.

diagnostics.message: Spreading `literal` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the getter `value`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the getter `value` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
